question: Which other classes of beings appear in the cosmic vision, O beloved?
premises: Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas are named
They form part of the vision
inference: The cosmic vision includes Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas, and Vidyādharas, O beloved.
